journey.name: wear nfc required
journey.description:
The watch app requires NFC hardware (`android.hardware.nfc`, required), so Play offers it only to watches with NFC. `uses-feature` is a store filter, not an install check, so the app still installs on the NFC-less emulators. `dumpsys package` does not list required features, so the check reads the installed APK with `aapt2` from the newest SDK build tools installed (journeys/wear/README.md › NFC sets `AAPT2`). Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: the dev watch app installed (README › Build and install) and `AAPT2` set (README › NFC); no wallet needed. Backend: none.

actions.action: Run `adb pull "$(adb shell pm path to.bitkit.dev | grep base.apk | sed 's/package://')" base.apk`
Run `"$AAPT2" dump badging base.apk | grep uses-feature` and verify it lists `android.hardware.nfc`
Run `"$AAPT2" dump badging base.apk | grep -c nfc.hce` and verify it prints 0: host card emulation is not required yet
